name: RC-B10-0577/2025 – After recital D – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
part_text: Da. whereas in 2024 over 276 mostly Christian schoolgirls were kidnapped by Boko Haram and allied groups, which have forced some abducted children to become soldiers or ‘wives’ and participate in attacks, including as suicide bombers;
